content.text:
Perfect! All 353 tests pass (added 16 new merge tests).

The customer merge feature is complete with:

**`src/customers.js`:**
- `mergeCustomers(customers, invoices, fromId, intoId)` function:
  - Merges duplicate customers by moving invoices and deleting the duplicate
  - Normalizes both customer IDs (trim whitespace, uppercase)
  - Returns ok({ customers, invoices }) with:
    - fromId customer removed from customers array
    - All invoices with customerId = fromId reassigned to intoId
  - Errors:
    - CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND if either ID doesn't exist
    - SAME_CUSTOMER if both IDs are the same customer
  - Non-mutating: creates new arrays and objects

**`src/errors.js`:**
- Added SAME_CUSTOMER error code

**Tests:**
- 16 comprehensive tests covering:
  - Basic merge functionality (customer removed, invoices reassigned)
  - Error cases (missing customers, same customer)
  - ID normalization (case insensitive, whitespace handling)
  - Multiple invoices from duplicate customer
  - No mutation of input arrays
  - Null array handling
  - Three+ customers in the system
  - Field preservation through merge
  - Mixed case and spacing in IDs
